==Hero Usage==
* Heroes appropriately use "Charge!" to boost the party's speed. They will not use "Charge!" if all party members are already under the effects of another movement increasing skill, e.g. [["Fall Back!"]]. They will only use this skill if there are 3 or more party members. Number of allies does not matter, despite the skill's description.

== Notes ==
* Primary [[PvP-only character|PvP-only]] warriors will be able to use this skill even if it is not [[unlock]]ed on their [[account]].
